raw:
Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: They listed an incorrect sequence of stations for the Franklin-Foxboro line, wrongly including Route 128, Canton Junction, Canton Center, Sharon, and Mansfield (which are on the Providence/Stoughton corridor) and omitting Islington, Norwood Depot, and Norwood Central. This mislisting placed Windsor Gardens at the wrong index and led to a miscount of 12 instead of the correct 10 stops between South Station and Windsor Gardens as of May 2023.
